name: Primo Plain Panels
title: Primo 12-Inch Seamless PVC Wall Panels
subtitle: 24 Architectural Finishes with Zero-Gap Anti-Seelan Protection
tagline: India's premier 12-inch wide seamless wall panels. 100% waterproof and termite-proof across 24 designer wood & marble textures.
description: Engineered specifically for Indian homes and NCR dampness issues. Primo 12-Inch Plain Panels feature a wide 300mm surface that dramatically minimizes seams, creating unbroken floor-to-ceiling visual luxury without peeling paint or moisture damage.

features.title: 100% Damp-Proof (Seelan-Free)
features.description: Zero water absorption. Closed-cell polymer stops peeling paint and seelan permanently.

features.title: Extra-Wide 12-Inch Coverage
features.description: 300mm breadth cuts visible joints by half compared to standard 6-inch panels.

features.title: Pre-Finished Diamond Shield
features.description: Zero painting, polishing or chemical maintenance needed. Wipe clean in seconds.

features.title: 24 Curated Architectural Finishes
features.description: From warm Burmese teaks to grey marbles and fabric textures, pre-matched for luxury interiors.

layers.name: Diamond Shield UV Topcoat
layers.description: Micro-embossed thermal coating protecting against UV fading, oil stains, fingerprints, and household abrasion.

layers.name: High-Definition Architectural Foil
layers.description: Fine wood grain and marble patterns with tactile surface embossing.

layers.name: Closed-Cell Polymer PVC Core
layers.description: Reinforced hollow-core extrusion providing high structural rigidity while remaining lightweight.

layers.name: Concealed Tongue-and-Groove Interlock
layers.description: Zero-gap interlocking joint system that hides all fasteners for seamless full-height walls.

faqs.question: Can Primo Plain Panels be installed directly over damp (seelan) walls in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR?
faqs.answer: Yes. Primo PVC panels feature a 100% closed-cell polymer core with 0.0% water absorption (ASTM D570 tested). They act as a permanent waterproof vapor barrier against rising dampness (seelan), efflorescence (shora), and peeling wall paint common in Gurgaon groundwater zones, keeping your room interior dry, mold-free, and pristine.

faqs.question: What is the price of Primo 12-inch plain wall panels per sq.ft and per panel in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Primo plain wall panels are priced at a wholesale rate of ₹499 per panel (MRP ₹999, 50% discount). Since each 9.5 ft × 12 in panel covers 9.5 sq.ft, the effective material rate is approximately ₹52.5 to ₹65 per sq.ft, making it 40% more cost-effective than timber cladding or wallpaper plus waterproofing treatments.

faqs.question: How are Primo Plain Panels joined together without visible gaps?
faqs.answer: Every Primo plank features an engineered concealed tongue-and-groove interlocking system. Planks slide into one another flush, hiding all mounting screws or brad nails beneath the joint. This creates an unbroken, smooth monolithic surface without ugly H-trim plastic joining strips.

faqs.question: Why choose 12-inch wide panels instead of traditional 6-inch or 8-inch panels?
faqs.answer: Standard PVC panels in India are only 6 to 8 inches wide, creating numerous visible vertical lines. Primo's 12-inch (300mm) breadth cuts joint lines by 50%, delivering a premium, seamless architectural aesthetic that mimics imported Italian laminate sheets and continuous marble slabs.

faqs.question: Are Primo PVC wall panels 100% termite and borer proof?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely. Unlike MDF, HDHMR, or plywood paneling that contain organic cellulose fibers which attract subterranean termites and wood borers, Primo panels are extruded from 100% virgin polymer with zero wood flour. Termites cannot feed on or penetrate the material.

faqs.question: Do I need to scrape or plaster the wall before installing Primo Plain Panels?
faqs.answer: No extensive wall preparation or POP putty is required. Primo panels can be installed directly over rough brickwork, uneven plaster, or damp peeling paint using adhesive or lightweight battens, saving you up to ₹25/sq.ft in civil preparation costs and eliminating construction dust.

faqs.question: Can Primo Plain Panels be installed in kitchens, bathrooms, and dining areas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Primo panels are resistant to grease splatters, turmeric stains, steam, and high humidity. The Diamond Shield UV topcoat allows you to easily wipe away oil, coffee, or food splashes using a standard damp microfiber cloth and mild household detergent.

faqs.question: How many pieces are in one carton box, and what area does it cover?
faqs.answer: Primo Plain Panels are packed in heavy-duty export cartons containing 10 pieces per box. One box covers 95 square feet (8.83 sq. meters), weighing approximately 28 kg for safe transport and scratch-free delivery across Gurgaon and Delhi NCR.

faqs.question: What is the lifespan of Primo PVC panels in extreme North Indian weather?
faqs.answer: Primo panels have an expected residential and commercial lifespan of 15 to 20+ years. They are dimensionally stable, meaning they will not expand, crack, or warp during Gurgaon's scorching 45°C summers or shrink during cold, humid winters.

faqs.question: Where is ready stock available, and what is the delivery timeline in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Goals Floors maintains a central wholesale distribution warehouse in Gurugram with ready container stock across all 24 plain finishes (GF-301 to GF-324). Express same-day or next-day delivery is available for Golf Course Road, DLF Phases 1-5, Sohna Road, Cyber City, and South Delhi.
